'''Fillen Danisher''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. He served under [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Octavian Grant]] acting as liaison to the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] before moving on to project lead of the [[Imperial Mining Corporation]]. Danisher used the resources of the Corporation to [[Mining/Legends|strip mine]] many [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] of their resources. The Governor was unscrupulous, and not above taking the lives of innocents.<ref name="FH" />

==Behind the scenes==
Fillen Danisher appeared in the role-playing sourcebook ''[[Far Horizons]]'' released in [[2014]] and developed by [[Sam Stewart]].<ref name="FH" />
